title: docs(skills): the two guides name the data-table bind warning instead of teaching a silent failure (objectui#11414)
body:
Fixes #11414

Clause-②: no

Six sentences in three published skill files taught that a `data-table` fed the wrong way fails with nothing on the console. Four of them are the card's: `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` (the paragraph beginning 「`useDataScope` is called by `list` and `tree-view`」 and the next one, 「`data-table` is not among them」) and `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` (the 「### Which components read `bind`」 section) said that a `bind` authored on a `data-table` fails 「with nothing thrown and nothing logged」 and that every non-reader component ignores `bind` with 「nothing in the console」 — false since objectui#6575, which logs one `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` console warning per such node. Two more came in with the seat's round-1 REWORK (comment 5943640678 on the card, which amended the claim's file surface for one sentence of `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`): the clause right after the four rewritten sentences in `data-integration.md`, and the sentence after the four-row table in `protocol.md`, both about a `data-table` whose `data` holds an unevaluated `${...}` string — the leg objectui#6665 gave its own `[ObjectUI] DataTable data:` warning. Every fenced example, every other sentence of the three files, the 「## Field-level conditional rules」 section of `schema-expressions.md` (objectui#11256's region) and the 「Readers only.」 line PR objectui#11410 landed are byte-identical; an empty-frontmatter changeset declares the docs-only change.

## What the sentences now say

The 「Every other component ignores `bind` completely — no error, no warning, nothing in the console.」 sentence, identically in both guides:

「Every other component ignores `bind` — no error, no warning, nothing in the console — except `data-table` (one warning, below).」

`data-integration.md`, the 「`data-table` is not among them」 paragraph — 「with nothing thrown and nothing logged」 becomes:

「renders a correct-looking header over an empty body: nothing is thrown and nothing on the page says why — the one signal is a `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` console warning (objectui#6575).」

and, in the same paragraph (round 1), 「Pointing the node's own `data` key at an expression (…) fails the same silent way — node keys are not expression-evaluated —」 becomes:

「… fails the same way, with its own console warning (`[ObjectUI] DataTable data:`, objectui#6665) — node keys are not expression-evaluated —」

`schema-expressions.md`, the 「`data-table` is the one that catches authors out」 paragraph — 「Nothing is thrown and nothing is logged — a table that looks built and is blank is the whole failure.」 becomes:

「Nothing is thrown and nothing on the page says why — the one signal is a `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:` console warning (objectui#6575); on the page, a table that looks built and is blank is the whole failure.」

`protocol.md`, the sentence after the four-row table (round 1) — 「Both failing legs fail the same way this file keeps warning about: a correct header over the empty state, nothing thrown, nothing logged.」 becomes:

「Both failing legs fail the same way: a correct header over the empty state, nothing thrown, a console warning each (`[ObjectUI] DataTable data:`, objectui#6665; dev-build `props`-bag warning, objectui#6708).」

The `bind` wording converges on what PR objectui#11410 gave `protocol.md`'s 「Readers only.」 clause: no error, nothing on the page says why, the render-time console warning is the one signal. The parser-tier half of that clause (`bind` is a base prop every node may carry, so it draws no `unknown-prop`, objectui#11008) is not spelled out in the guides, to stay inside the line budget — 「the one signal」 already asserts it, and the pin under assumption 2 measures it.

## Mechanism assumptions, each measured on this branch

1. Render tier, `bind` — `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/dataTableBindDiagnostic.ts` (`describeIgnoredBind`, prefix constant `DATA_TABLE_BIND_DIAGNOSTIC_PREFIX`) is the only `bind` diagnostic: `data-table.tsx` calls it from one `useEffect` and prints one `console.warn`. A grep of every `packages/*/src` file (tests excluded) for a `console.warn` or `console.error` line mentioning `bind` finds that module and `ElementDataSourceGate.tsx`'s `bindingCapMessage`, which is about a `dataSource` binding's row cap, not the `bind` key. No other renderer logs about `bind`, so 「every other component ignores `bind` … nothing in the console」 holds for the non-readers and is false for `data-table` alone. A source reading, not a runtime census — what it rules out is a second logger, which is the sentence's claim.
2. Parser tier — `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` holds `const BASE_PROPS = basePropNames('every-node')` and `bind` is an `'every-node'` row, so a `bind` on any node draws no `unknown-prop`. Pinned by `packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx` (the case named 「`data-table` + `bind` draws nothing here — its render-time console warning is the one signal」, with the lit `bindTo` control still drawing `unknown-prop`). Green on this branch.
3. Fence readers — `packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx` reads the fenced JSON blocks of both guides and of `protocol.md` through `blocksOfType`; `packages/types/src/__tests__/list-bind-only-11405.test.ts` reads both guides' marked `list` fences; `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` parses every marked fence. All read fences, none reads this prose, and no fence moved in either round.
4. Render tier, non-array `data` (round 1) — the REWORK's premise was that both failing rows of `protocol.md`'s table draw the `[ObjectUI] DataTable data:` warning. Measured through the real `SchemaRenderer` with a one-off probe (not committed; the same `tree()` harness as `data-table-node-data-diagnostic.test.tsx`, every `console.warn` and `console.error` captured per row): the node-level `data: "${data.customers}"` row draws one `[ObjectUI] DataTable data:` warning (`describeNonArrayData`, objectui#6665) plus, in this test environment, one `[ObjectUI] Unevaluated expression reached the DOM` error from `@object-ui/react`'s `reportUnevaluatedExpressions`; the `props: { data: "${data.customers}" }` row draws NO `DataTable data:` warning and no error — `props` is spread as React props and never hoisted, so the renderer's `data` stays `undefined` (absence, not a non-array value) — and its one line is 「[ObjectUI] A `props` config bag was not read - node `data-table`」 from `reportDroppedPropsBag` (objectui#6708), which `SchemaRenderer` calls under `if (__DEV__)`. The premise was therefore half false, and the `protocol.md` sentence names each leg's own warning instead of crediting both with one; the `data-integration.md` clause is about the node-level key only and names `DataTable data:`. 「a console warning each」 is deliberately not 「one console line each」: the node-level row also carries the error above.

## Tests run on this branch

Under the shared verify lock, on `4d99d286` (and on `f7b1125c` before the protocol.md rewrite): `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/__tests__/skill-guide-data-table-binding.test.tsx packages/components/src/renderers/__tests__/bind-base-prop-parser-tier-11008.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-node-data-diagnostic.test.tsx packages/types/src/__tests__/list-bind-only-11405.test.ts` → `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 49 passed (49)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The probe under assumption 4 ran once beside them (its first version, asserting a `DataTable data:` warning on the `props` row, FAILED with 「expected [] to have a length of 1」 — that failure is the measurement; its second version only recorded each row's console lines, 3 passed) and was deleted before either commit; `git status` was clean at both.

## Line budget (skills tree rule)

| reading | before (`cf38a6ce`, the merge-base) | after (`4d99d286`) | net |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md`, whole file | 513 | 515 | +2 |
| `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md`, whole file | 635 | 636 | +1 |
| `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`, whole file | 370 | 371 | +1 |
| whole bundle, every `skills/objectui/**/*.md` (16 files) | 4808 | 4812 | +4 |
| every `skills/*/SKILL.md` (one file, `skills/objectui/SKILL.md`) | 142 | 142 | 0 |

Budget was at most +4 across the three files; used +4 — round 0 spent +2, round 1 one line per file. The `protocol.md` sentence paid for the two warning names by dropping its own connective 「this file keeps warning about」 (the table above it is what that phrase pointed at), which is what kept that file at +1. objectui has no skills token ratchet (`check:skill-eval-tokens` is the eval `must_contain` oracle, not a size gate), so lines are the reading.

## Gates run locally

Derived by hand from objectui's `.github/workflows/*.yml` (objectui has no `dispatch-gates.mjs`). Exit codes were captured before any pipe: each command is redirected to its own log and its status is read on that same shell line. Round 0 ran everything on `2799beea`; round 1 merged `origin/main` `cf38a6ce` (which carries PR objectui#11410's `protocol.md` edit and objectui#11254's fields/gantt fix, touching nothing else under `skills/`) and re-ran the fence readers and every diff-reading gate on `4d99d286`.

| gate (workflow) | command | exit |
|---|---|---|
| Skills Paths | `node scripts/check-skills-paths.mjs` | 0 — 89/90 stated paths resolve, 1 baselined (re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Skill Eval Tokens | `node scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs --self-test` (round 0), then the run | 0 / 0 — every `must_contain` token is taught, 0 red beyond baseline (run re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Skill Examples | `pnpm exec turbo run build $(node scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs --build-filter) --concurrency=2` under `os-verify-lock.sh` (29/29 tasks, 4m11s, VERDICT command-exit 0), then `--self-test` (60 cases), then the corpus run | 0 / 0 / 0 on `2799beea` — 18 ts fences judged, 70 json fences parsed, 0 failed. NOT re-run in round 1: the gate reads marked fences only and no fence changed in `protocol.md` or the guides (prose-only diff); CI runs it on the head |
| Line Citation Gate | `node scripts/check-new-cross-file-line-citations.mjs` | 0 — 0 new citations (re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Control Bytes | `node scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs` | 0 — 9941 tracked text files scanned on `4d99d286`; own control-char grep of the edited files: no match |
| Changeset Presence | `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` | 0 — 4 files changed, 0 published source, 1 changeset added (re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Changeset Guard | `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` | 0 / 0 — 1 added, 0 pre-existing modified (re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Changeset Claim Re-read | `node scripts/check-changeset-claims.mjs` | 0 (report-only; re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Governed Surface Guard | `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test` (188 cases, round 0), then `--test` over the four changed paths | 0 / 3 GOVERNED (`skills/**` x3) — the expected answer; this PR stays draft |
| Shell Escape Residue | `node scripts/check-shell-escape-residue.mjs` | 0 (re-run on `4d99d286`) |
| Lint, CI | both workflows' 「Decide whether this change needs a full run」 step excludes `**/*.md` and `.changeset/**`, so on this diff they report and skip every heavy step | NOT MEASURED locally, by the workflows' own design |
| doc-* workflows | `check-doc-component-types` (its header: not `skills/**`), `check-doc-snippet-types` (its header: `skills/objectui/**` is claimed by no gate there), `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-links` do not read `skills/**` | not reached by this diff |

## Deviations

- Round 1 added two sentences outside the card's four: the 「fails the same silent way」 clause in `data-integration.md` (same paragraph, which the round-0 edit had left contradicting its neighbour) and the sentence after the four-row table in `skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md`. Both were ordered by the seat's REWORK comment 5943640678, which amended claim 5943352305's file surface to include `protocol.md` for that one sentence as a bounded in-place fix (same defect class, mechanical, no other claim on the file after PR objectui#11410 merged, same gate family). The 「Readers only.」 line was not touched.
- The REWORK's mechanism premise that both failing rows draw the `DataTable data:` warning was measured false for the `props` row (assumption 4); the `protocol.md` wording follows the measurement, not the premise.
- Toolchain: this container's Node is `v22.22.0`, below the `^22.22.2` floor `jsdom@30.0.1` declares, and `.npmrc` sets `engine-strict=true`, so a bare `pnpm install` was refused (`ERR_PNPM_UNSUPPORTED_ENGINE`). Installed with `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` for that one invocation, in both rounds; no tracked file touched; CI pins `node-version: '22.x'`, above the floor.

## Acceptance notes

- Two test-file header comments still carry the old phrase: `packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-node-data-diagnostic.test.tsx` (「with nothing thrown and nothing logged」 — it describes the pre-diagnostic behaviour that file pins, and says so) and `packages/types/src/__tests__/base-bind-declared.test.ts` (noted by PR objectui#11410). Not shipped, not pins.
- `content/docs/guide/schema-rendering.md`'s chart paragraph (「draws with nothing in it — no error, no warning」) is about `chart`, not `data-table`, and is not measured here.
- The `props`-row control (`props: { data: [literal array] }`) renders the empty state with nothing logged at all in the probe — the dev-build props-bag warning fires only for a `props` bag carrying a dropped key the diagnostic recognises as such. Outside every sentence this PR touches; recorded as a reading, not edited.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** —— 三份发布给作者的技能文件里的六句话。第一轮改卡上的四句:`skills/objectui/guides/data-integration.md` 与 `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` 都说「在 `data-table` 上写 `bind`,什么都不抛、什么都不记录」,以及「其它所有组件忽略 `bind`,控制台里什么都没有」;现在改为:无错误、页面上无提示,唯一信号是渲染期一条控制台警告 `[ObjectUI] DataTable bind:`(objectui#6575),「其它所有组件」一句原地点名 `data-table` 是唯一例外。第二轮(席位 REWORK)再改两句同类的话:`data-integration.md` 同一段里「`data` 写成表达式字串时同样静默失败」,改为点名它自己的警告 `[ObjectUI] DataTable data:`(objectui#6665);`skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md` 四行表格之后那句「nothing thrown, nothing logged」,改为逐腿点名:节点级 `data` 字串触发 `[ObjectUI] DataTable data:` 警告,`props` 腿触发开发构建下的 `props` 袋警告(objectui#6708)。三文件合计净增 4 行(预算 +4),示例、其它句子与 PR objectui#11410 刚落地的「Readers only.」一行一字未动;另加一个空 frontmatter 的 changeset 声明「不发版」。

**为什么改** —— 这些句子是 AI 写元数据时读的教材。旧句子是假的:自 objectui#6575 与 objectui#6665 起渲染器都会在控制台说话,写错的教材会让作者去找一个不存在的静默陷阱、或忽略真实存在的警告。第一轮改完后同一段里还剩一句「同样静默」与新句自相矛盾,第二轮补齐。`protocol.md` 那句原本按席位假设写成「两腿都触发 `DataTable data:` 警告」,实测 `props` 腿并不触发(`props` 不会被提升到节点上,渲染器根本看不到那个 `data`),于是按实测分腿写,而不是照假设写。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** —— 纯文档改动,无代码、无发布包源码变动。风险只在措辞是否精确:`bind` 的「唯一信号」由两条已存在的 pin 测试覆盖(渲染期恰一条警告;解析层不报 `unknown-prop`),节点级 `data` 腿的警告由 `data-table-node-data-diagnostic.test.tsx` 覆盖,`props` 腿的读数来自本分支上一次性探针(未入库)。本分支上 4 个测试文件 / 49 个测试全绿,全部 diff 门禁重跑全绿。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的 commits。

**席位意见** ——(留空,席位定稿)

**你要做的** —— 受管面(`skills/**`,Tier H):本 PR 恒为 draft。请 `os-zhuang` / `hotlong` 之一留下 APPROVED review;之后由认领席翻 ready 并入队,dev 不做这两步。
